ask: Where should pollen post the launch notice?
why: The notice goes out in the owner's name, and each place costs something different.

options.label: The newsletter only
options.does: pollen sends the notice to the newsletter's readers and nowhere else.

options.label: A paid placement
options.does: pollen books one placement and spends no more than the most it can cost.

other: Say what you want instead, and pollen revises the plan from it.
no: Nothing is posted. pollen keeps the draft.

facts.name: Most it can cost
facts.text: 1,000 kr, set aside before the first click

facts.name: Who sees it
facts.text: people outside the garden, in the owner's name

rulings.text: Public posts go out in the owner's name only after the owner's yes.
Spend nothing on ads before the product has users.
